name: Bello + Dress Down — no false source-viability dependency
notes: Memory: project_ability_source_viability_fix_2026-04-07. A full REMOVE_ABILITIES effect made Bello's same-layer ADD_ABILITY look dependent on it, forcing non-timestamp ordering. Bello has the earlier timestamp, so layer 6 must run Bello then Dress Down: Bello grants Gilded Lotus indestructible and haste, then Dress Down strips them again (CR 613.6 keeps Bello's grant applying even though Bello loses its own abilities). Lotus ends a 4/4 Artifact Creature - Elemental with no abilities.
